title: Chat system prompt, rewritten for iteration 2
intro: The chat's system prompt, rewritten from zero for a model that knows generic tool calling and nothing about the harness (your spec, the iteration 1 diagnosis, a Haiku newcomer review, and the new hub behaviour). `CHAT_BASE` is hub/chat (~3,700 words); `CHAT_SMALL_BASE` is hub/chat_small (~770 words, static toolset). After the fixed text come `<systems>` (each system's new `about`), the mode's guide, then context. Comment on any line; give the file a verdict. Once you're happy, iteration 2 runs: decision models off / on / load, 40 cases × 3 each.
